Those commits name every recent model, from Sonnet 4.5 to Opus 5.5. Could open source harnesses do that? Sure, if they were programmed in a similar fashion as Claude Code. Do you have any evidence of it happening?

[Hacker News] Will look into exposing that in hooks.
